He speaks with active facial expressions, squinting his eyes and moving his mouth expressively. He gestures frequently with his hands, pointing with his index finger and opening his palms toward the camera. (2) A small circular inset appears on screen showing two young girls with dark hair looking at books together in a brightly lit indoor setting. The main character continues to speak while two bottles of blue and white laundry products, labeled 'Lenor', are positioned on a white table in front of him. (3) A close-up shot features a person's hand pouring white crystalline scent beads from a transparent bottle into a blue measuring cap. The background shows the metallic interior of a washing machine drum. (4) The camera shows a stack of neatly folded light-colored clothing sitting on a wooden shelf illuminated by warm light. Yellow sparkle graphic icons are overlaid on the clothes. The man is then shown holding a yellow cloth to his nose, closing his eyes as if smelling it with a satisfied expression. (5) The final scene displays the man centered within a large white speech bubble graphic against a yellow grid background. He smiles and points toward two product bottles displayed on the right side of the frame.

(4) A female voice briefly asks a question with a clear, inquisitive rising intonation; the music volume ducks slightly during her speech. (5) A series of 'pop' and 'sparkle' sound effects punctuate the audio as the male voice describes product benefits. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and Major tonality. (6) Brief percussive sounds of beads rattling in a plastic container are audible over the continuous music bed. The speaker's arousal level remains high and positive. It positions pleasant-smelling laundry as a form of non-verbal communication that helps children make a positive first impression and build interpersonal relationships.
